note: Rung 0 of the oblique ladder: 0.5 deg steps, onset |azErr| 0.35 deg. Expect both stick channels under the 0.02 analysis deadband: read terminalOffDeg, settleOn and rollCmdMedian, not rollYawOpposedPct. AIRFRAME: any jet at the fixedwing-v2 entry condition.
